biggest_catch: Back Market's marketplace is for professional refurbishers only — as an individual you use their BuyBack service, selling to professionals, not setting your own price.
catches: The marketplace itself is professional-only; individuals cannot list directly — BuyBack is the individual path.
BuyBack is free for individuals except shipping fees that may apply (article 13.2.2 of the T&Cs).
You accept the refurbisher's quote, not your own ask price — get quotes from 2–3 buyback services to compare.
Devices must be working/as-described or the quote gets adjusted down after inspection.
Shipping costs (if not prepaid) come out of your payout.
Paid out by the refurbisher after they receive and inspect the device — timing is days, not hours.

c1.evidence: Official Back Market BuyBack Terms (US T&Cs, hosted on Back Market's own CDN): the platform lets 'private individuals, consumers or professionals, to resell used electronic products to professionals, so that they can refurbish them for resale'; 'The BuyBack service is free of charge for Individuals (with the exception of shipping fees)'

c2.evidence: Concrete: free for individuals, quote-based payout, ship-to-refurbisher flow

c3.evidence: No listing fees; service free for individuals.

c4.evidence: Payout varies by device — quote given upfront before you ship.

eligibility: Individuals can resell used electronic products via BuyBack; marketplace selling is professional-only
maximize: Back Market BuyBack usually out-quotes carrier trade-ins for mid-range phones because refurbishers compete on margin, not subsidy math — but compare against Apple's/Amazon's trade-in and a direct eBay sale before accepting. Wipe and factory-reset the device, include the original charger/box if you have them, and photograph the condition before shipping to dispute any inspection downgrades. Answer the condition questions conservatively — an honest 'good' that becomes 'excellent' at inspection sometimes pays more than an 'excellent' that gets downgraded.
notes: Grounded on Back Market's official BuyBack Terms & Conditions (US). Deliberately scoped to the individual BuyBack path since marketplace selling requires a professional business. Distinct from generic trade-in routes by quote-competition across refurbishers.
payout_quote: The BuyBack service is free of charge for Individuals (with the exception of shipping fees that may be incurred)... The platform allows private individuals, consumers or professionals, to resell used electronic products to professionals, so that they can refurbish them for resale.

repeatable.cadence: Repeatable per device — run it again every time you upgrade a phone, laptop, or tablet.

s1.note: Individuals may resell via BuyBack per official T&Cs.

s2.note: Free for individuals; shipping fees may apply.

s3.note: Paid after refurbisher receives/inspects device; timing in days.

s4.note: Concrete terms; payout varies by device quote.

s6.note: 5 steps: describe device, accept quote, ship, inspection, get paid.

steps: Describe your used electronic device on Back Market's BuyBack service
Receive a quote from the refurbisher
Compare the quote with carrier/Apple/Amazon trade-in offers
Accept, wipe and factory-reset the device, and ship it
Get paid after the refurbisher receives and inspects it
who_pays: The refurbisher (Back Market's buyback partner) pays you after receiving and inspecting your device — Back Market itself doesn't hand you cash.
who_qualifies: Individuals can resell used electronic products via BuyBack; the main Back Market marketplace is professional-only — individuals can't list directly.
work_available: The BuyBack program is active and free for individuals (per article 13.2.2 of the T&Cs).
what_gets_accepted: Devices must be working and as described — if inspection finds issues, the quote gets adjusted down. You accept the refurbisher's quote, not your own ask price, so get quotes from 2–3 buyback services to compare.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free for individuals except shipping fees that may apply (if not prepaid, they come out of your payout). Unpaid time goes to getting quotes, wiping and packaging the device, and shipping.
when_cash_arrives: Days, not hours — after the refurbisher receives and inspects your device, they pay you out.
